Product Name
Buildables v3
Category: Hardware workflow automation platform for mechanical engineers
Deployment: Cloud + optional local hosting

Core Problem We Are Solving
Mechanical engineers design under uncertainty.

Uncertainty comes from:
Incomplete supplier information
Fragmented standards and handbooks
Lost sourcing context (Excel, email, tribal knowledge)

No consistent way to sanity-check designs before they become expensive mistakes
No structured way to pass engineering reasoning to others

Buildables reduces uncertainty without replacing engineering judgment.

Target Users
Primary:
Lead mechanical engineers
Senior mechanical engineers
Hardware-focused startups and SMEs

Secondary:
Junior engineers
Non-engineers working under engineering supervision
Educators and prototyping environments (social impact version)

Product Architecture Overview
Single interface with three tightly integrated pillars.
The product behaves like an IDE for hardware engineering workflows.

PILLAR 3: ENGINEERING COPILOT (CORE ENTRY WEDGE)
Purpose

Support engineering decision-making, reviews, and documentation by acting as a second engineer.
Capabilities
Engineers can ask:
How would another engineer approach this design?
What risks or assumptions might I be missing?
What standards or guidelines apply here?

References:
Uploaded internal documents
Engineering handbooks
Standards (where licensed or provided by the user)
Can cite specific sections or clauses when answering

Can review:
Design assumptions
Calculations
Tolerance decisions
Assembly logic

Generates:
Design review notes
Action items from reviews
Documentation for handoff
Can generate scripts or calculations to automate repetitive analysis tasks
Can question missing inputs rather than hallucinating

Constraints
Does not make final design decisions
Does not auto-approve designs
Outputs must be auditable by another engineer

Non-Engineer Mode
Structured planning mode
Step-by-step guidance constrained by standards
No freeform design without defined requirements

PILLAR 2: SOURCING AND BOM INTELLIGENCE
Purpose
Eliminate Excel-based sourcing workflows and loss of supplier context.

Capabilities
BOM creation and management with sourcing context attached

Parts linked to:
DigiKey for prototyping (low MOQ, higher cost)
Manufacturing suppliers for scale (regional and international)

Tracks:
Why a part was chosen based on the measurements and calculation, materials and how compatible are the parts
Alternatives considered
MOQ, lead time, region
things to take note (lack of information in datasheet)

Supplier discovery:
US, Europe, China
Can simulate browsing supplier sites to extract relevant data
BOMs do not break when moving from prototype to production
Designed for engineers, not procurement-only workflows

Constraints
Does not auto-purchase
Engineers retain final supplier selection authority

PILLAR 1: CONCEPT FORMATION USING EXISTING PARTS
Purpose
Enable realistic concept design using verified, existing components.

Capabilities
Generate CAD concepts constrained by real parts
Uses verified CAD libraries and component data
Exports to standard CAD formats

Supports:
Prototyping
Educational builds
Reuse of existing inventory

Especially useful where:
Lead time matters
Budget is constrained
Waste reduction is important

Social Impact Extension
Convert leftover or unused hardware components into functional prototypes
Suitable for classrooms, workshops, and resource-limited environments

CORE PLATFORM FEATURES
Topic-based chat system
Each topic becomes contextual memory
Users can close topics to prevent context bleed
Searchable topic history
Document ingestion and referencing
Optional local hosting for sensitive IP
Designed for future integration with CAD and analysis tools
